## Goal
- Establish and prove bounded, approval-gated IVX self-healing: continuous scan, durable incidents, safe containment/repair workflow, SHA-parity deployment verification, and controlled certification without production mutation.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use only `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`; treat protected `main` as production.
- Never deploy production automatically or mutate production infrastructure without required owner approval.
- Do not modify production secrets, databases/RLS, authentication, payments, AWS/DNS/Render/Supabase, signing, or destructive data without explicit owner approval.
- Never edit `main` directly; isolate one incident per `auto-fix/<incident-id>` branch and PR.
- Safe autonomous scope: TypeScript/lint/import/test/workflow/UI/loading/cache/retry/duplicate-request repairs.
- Required workflows: `IVX CI`, `IVX QA Suite`, `IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline`, `Android Emulator QA`, and `iOS Simulator QA`.
- Do not claim zero crashes, unmeasured response times, completed certification, active monitoring, rollback, or production verification without evidence.
- Final acceptance string may only be returned after all user-listed monitoring, persistence, controlled-test, workflow, SHA-parity, restart-recovery, mobile-evidence, and owner-control requirements are proven.

## Progress
### Done
- Previous GitHub Actions billing/spending blocker was resolved:
  ```text
  Product=Actions
  budget=$20
  Stop usage=Yes
  ```
- Historical `IVX CI` run `30762630846`, attempt `3`, obtained GitHub-hosted runners and executed real jobs on:
  ```text
  012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```
- Historical real runner evidence exists for:
  ```text
  Chat + intent + performance tests
  Backend tests (bun)
  Secret scan
  Android release consistency
  ```
- Historical `IVX CI` attempt `3` passed secret scan, backend tests, and chat/intent/performance tests.
- `recovery/canonical-main` is currently resolvable again and reports:
  ```text
  ## main...origin/main [ahead 1]
  42fd09aec234452527c394d6602d50e9a1ae1c5c HEAD -> main Restored the automated testing system and fixed several application errors.
  ```
- Root checkout reports the same state:
  ```text
  ## main...origin/main [ahead 1]
  42fd09aec234452527c394d6602d50e9a1ae1c5c HEAD -> main Restored the automated testing system and fixed several application errors.
  ```
- Production health probe succeeded:
  ```text
  curl --silent --show-error --fail-with-body --max-time 20 "https://api.ivxholding.com/health"
  ```
  It reported `status:"healthy"`, enabled senior-developer runtime, GitHub read/push capability, and Render deploy capability.
- Production version probe succeeded:
  ```text
  https://api.ivxholding.com/version
  ```
  Runtime SHA remains:
  ```text
  012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```
- Existing backend crash-safe task orchestration test suite passed:
  ```text
  bun test backend/services/ivx-task-orchestrator.test.ts backend/services/operational-memory/engineering-intelligence.test.ts
  ```
  Result:
  ```text
  4 pass
  0 fail
  ```
- Verified existing durable task-state and restart-resume implementation:
  ```text
  backend/services/ivx-task-state-store.ts
  backend/services/ivx-task-orchestrator.ts
  ```
  including atomic block state persistence, append-only task events, durable cursor, crash recovery, and approval gating.
- Verified existing operational execution-loop safety model:
  ```text
  backend/services/operational-memory/execution-loop.ts
  ```
  It captures a GitHub/Render rollback token and records failures, but explicitly does not independently edit/push/deploy.
- Verified existing incident detection logic in:
  ```text
  backend/services/operational-memory/engineering-intelligence.ts
  ```
  with severity classification for API error rate, Render deploy failure, Supabase reachability, latency, queues, auth, and investor workflows.
- Native scaffold repairs were completed independently of the Expo repository:
  ```text
  android-ivx-holdings/gradle/libs.versions.toml
  android-ivx-holdings/app/build.gradle.kts
  android-ivx-holdings/app/src/main/java/com/ivxholdings/app/ui/screens/OwnerDashboardScreen.kt
  ```
  - Added `io.ktor:ktor-client-logging`.
  - Restored local `ActionCard`.
  - Final Android release build check succeeded.

### In Progress
- Audit existing self-healing, incident persistence, containment, workflow, and recovery capabilities in small isolated batches.
- Determine the trustworthy remote/canonical GitHub state because both available local checkouts are ahead of `origin/main` at:
  ```text
  42fd09aec234452527c394d6602d50e9a1ae1c5c
  ```
  while production runtime reports:
  ```text
  012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```
- Establish evidence for actual GitHub Actions runner status, workflow runs, CI-tested SHA, and deployment relationship before creating any repair branch.
- Revalidate the Expo Android release-version mismatch against the currently available checkout before making its previously proposed repair.

### Blocked
- GitHub Actions API inspection is blocked by invalid/unavailable local credentials:
  ```text
  curl ... https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/actions/runs?per_page=10
  curl: (22) The requested URL returned error: 401
  jq: error (at <stdin>:4): Cannot iterate over null (null)
  ```
- No current evidence proves GitHub remote `main`, CI tested SHA, Render deployed SHA, `/health` SHA, and `/version` SHA parity.
- Local checkout is ahead of its configured Rork-router `origin`; it is not safe evidence of canonical GitHub `main`:
  ```text
  origin https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu
  ```
- No verified auto-fix branch, commit SHA, pushed PR URL, CI run ID, approval, merge, deployment ID, rollback result, or post-repair runtime evidence exists for the requested self-healing certification.
- No durable production incident schema/ledger evidence was verified for all required incident fields: incident ID, trace ID, affected users, stack trace, production SHA, mitigation, and repair state.
- No active real-time crash-monitoring evidence was verified for Android, iOS, JavaScript, backend, Render restart loops, queue heartbeats, blank screens, memory exhaustion, upload/auth failures, or SHA mismatch.
- No verified automated containment/feature-flag disablement/rollback execution exists.
- No heartbeat workflow, heartbeat run, or `RUNNER_HEARTBEAT_PASS` evidence exists.
- No required workflow has three consecutive successful runs from one verified SHA; branch protection still lacks required CI status-check evidence:
  ```text
  requiredStatusChecks=null
  ```
- No controlled self-healing certification tests have been executed for TypeScript failure, API timeout, duplicate chat messages, failed deployment verification, or worker restart.
- Runtime log sources are incomplete:
  ```text
  rork-agent logs runtime --errors
  No runtime logs found for this project.
  ```
- Backend log retrieval command was malformed because the agent limit exceeds the supported maximum:
  ```text
  rork-agent logs backend --limit 200
  "Too big: expected number to be <=100"
  ```
- AI gateway logs show historical upstream failures, including:
  ```text
  responseStatus":412
  "Precondition Failed"
  statusCode":503
  "Service temporarily unavailable"
  ```
  No corresponding durable incident/containment/recovery evidence was established.
- Production Android/iOS crash evidence remains unavailable.
- Production Android signing remains owner-protected:
  ```text
  IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE
  IVX_RELEASE_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
  IVX_RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS
  IVX_RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD
  ```

## Key Decisions
- Do not report `SELF_HEALING_ACTIVE_VERIFIED`; present state does not satisfy the requested proof requirements.
- Treat `/health` and `/version` responses as limited runtime observations, not proof of CI/deployment/SHA certification.
- Do not activate or simulate production rollback, deploy, secret, database, authentication, signing, or infrastructure changes without owner approval.
- Keep self-healing repairs bounded: use an `auto-fix/<incident-id>` branch, a failing regression test before the repair, focused validation, review, push, PR, CI, and approval-gated deployment.
- Do not use the current local checkout or Rork-router remote as proof of canonical GitHub `main` until authenticated GitHub remote state is captured.
- Keep `android-ivx-holdings/` separate from the canonical Expo Android production path.
- Correct backend-log invocation to use `--limit 100` or lower before drawing incident conclusions.

## Next Steps
1. Restore authenticated read-only GitHub Actions/repository access and capture remote `main` SHA, recent workflow run IDs, conclusions, and runner evidence.
2. Compare remote GitHub `main` SHA with local `42fd09aec234452527c394d6602d50e9a1ae1c5c` and runtime `012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c`; do not mutate either until discrepancy is explained.
3. Query backend logs with:
   ```text
   rork-agent logs backend --limit 100
   ```
   then correlate health/version, Render, gateway, and application evidence into non-production incident records.
4. Inspect existing operational-memory persistence and API routes for required incident fields, heartbeat handling, idempotency, checkpoint recovery, and SHA-parity verification gaps.
5. Re-run:
   ```text
   node expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs
   ```
   in the verified canonical checkout; if the mismatch remains, create one isolated `auto-fix/<incident-id>` branch with a regression test and no direct `main` edit.
6. Create a separate minimal runner-heartbeat workflow branch/PR that prints `RUNNER_OS`, `GITHUB_REPOSITORY`, `GITHUB_REF`, and `RUNNER_HEARTBEAT_PASS`, without secrets.
7. Add only bounded, non-production self-healing foundation changes after the audit: durable incident lifecycle, evidence capture, idempotency/checkpoint tests, and explicit approval gates.
8. Execute each controlled certification fixture only in an isolated environment after its incident ledger, branch/PR flow, and test harness exist.
9. Require PR approval, merge evidence, CI tested SHA, deployment ID, `LIVE` status, `/health`, `/version`, smoke tests, runtime SHA equality, and rollback availability before marking any incident verified.
